class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.codes = codes or {}
        self.runs = []

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        print(f'RUN-MARKER {run.label}')
        self.runs.append(run)
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)

    @property
    def labels(self):
        return [r.label for r in self.runs]


def registry_root(tmp_path, text):
    (tmp_path / 'build').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (tmp_path / 'build' / 'suites.toml').write_text(text)
    return tmp_path


def call(argv, root, run_one=None):
    try:
        return rs.main(argv, root=root, run_one=run_one or Recorder())
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return exc.code


def suites_of(text):
    return rs.parse(tomllib.loads(text))


def by_name(suites, name):
    return next(s for s in suites if s.name == name)


def git(root, *args):
    subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True)


def make_repo(root, registry, tracked=(), untracked=(), ignored=None):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    git(root, 'init', '-q')
    registry_root(root, registry)
    for rel in (*tracked, *untracked):
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text('def test_x():\n    pass\n')
    to_add = ['build/suites.toml', *tracked]
    if ignored:
        (root / '.gitignore').write_text(ignored)
        to_add.append('.gitignore')
    git(root, 'add', *to_add)
    return root

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- real subprocess

def fake_uv(tmp_path, monkeypatch, exit_code=0):
    bindir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bindir.mkdir()
    uv = bindir / 'uv'
    uv.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%s\\n" "$PWD" "$PROBE_VAR" "$*" > "$PROBE_OUT"\n'
                  f'exit {exit_code}\n')
    uv.chmod(uv.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC)
    out = tmp_path / 'probe.txt'
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', f'{bindir}{os.pathsep}{os.environ.get("PATH", "")}')
    monkeypatch.setenv('PROBE_VAR', 'sweep-on')
    monkeypatch.setenv('PROBE_OUT', str(out))
    return out

# spec: "Stdlib only (`tomllib`, `argparse`, `subprocess`, `shlex`), Python 3.13."
# task: 2
def test_runner_is_stdlib_only():
    tree = ast.parse((REPO_ROOT / 'build' / 'run_suites.py').read_text())
    mods = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            mods |= {a.name.split('.')[0] for a in node.names}
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0:
            mods.add(node.module.split('.')[0])
    assert mods <= set(sys.stdlib_module_names) | {'__future__'}
    assert rs.REGISTRY == 'build/suites.toml'
